notes:
• Files in replies open in Stellwerk: links to files (relative, absolute, `<…>`, `file://`, with `:42` or `#L42`), inline code and paths in the text (`.context/plan.md`, `src/foo.ts:12`) become clickable when the host finds the file in the workspace. On the Mac they open in the tab next to the chats (Markdown rendered) instead of failing with "Das Programm kann nicht geöffnet werden. -50"; on iPhone, iPad and Android in a preview. All files now lists `.context` too.
• Workspaces can be pinned above the projects and renamed: right-click on the Mac, swipe or long-press on iPhone and iPad, long-press on Android.
• Mac: the host no longer stops answering for hours (phones and other Macs couldn't connect, the window couldn't send) when many tools ran at once. git, gh, Tailscale, Entire and the helper calls (Operator line, branch name, new topic) now wait on threads of their own, and the project list asks git outside the database. A stalled host now says so in the host log until it's over, including a refused connection, and writes where its threads wait into `stall-<date>.txt` beside the log.
• Settings → Devices: "Name on the phone" is now "Host name". It names this Mac at the top left of the Stellwerk window too, and a rename shows there and in the apps as soon as you press Return or leave the field, instead of on the next reconnect.
• Mac: a click on an image in a chat opens the viewer with all of the chat's images again (the strip at the bottom, the arrows and ← →), not just that one.
• On a team host, Settings → Devices lists only your own phones and Macs, and you can no longer remove someone else's. A malformed video request can no longer crash the host. Android build tools updated.
• Team host: a message written while someone else's turn runs no longer goes into that turn (it would run on their Claude account). It waits in the queue without Send now, and starts a turn of your own when theirs ends. The same on iPhone, Android and the Mac.
• Mac: the chat tabs no longer show the wide system scroll bar when a mouse is connected. When the tabs don't fit, a thin bar like the one in the chat shows while you scroll and then fades out. The tabs in Search use the same bar.
• An archive or run script that a workspace changed in its own settings (so an agent may have written it) now runs only after you allow it: iPhone, iPad, Android and the Mac ask "Run the changed archive script?" or "Run the changed run script?", and remember the answer per project and command. On team hosts, a device that hasn't signed in no longer sees who is typing or looking at which chat. Release builds now use the Swift package versions committed in `Package.resolved`.
